The type is closely related to the job type. Different job types support different worker types.

- **TFJob**: Supports Chief, PS, Worker, Evaluator, and GraphLearn.

- **PyTorchJob**: Supports Worker and Master.

- **XGBoostJob**: Supports Worker and Master.

- **OneFlowJob**: Supports Worker and Master.

- **ElasticBatch**: Supports Worker and Master.

For PyTorchJob, XGBoostJob, OneFlowJob, and ElasticBatch, the Master is optional. If you do not specify a Master, the system automatically designates the first worker node as the Master.

schema.description: The request body parameters.

DisplayName.description:
The name of the job. The name must follow these rules:

- The name can be up to 256 characters long.

- It can contain digits, letters, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

JobType.description:
The job type. This parameter is case-sensitive. The supported job types are:

- TFJob

- PyTorchJob

- MPIJob

- XGBoostJob

- OneFlowJob

- ElasticBatchJob

- SlurmJob

- RayJob

- DataJuicerJob

JobSpecs.description:
**JobSpecs** describes the runtime configurations for the job, such as the registry address, start command, node resource declaration, and number of replicas.

A PAI-DLC job consists of different types of nodes. Nodes of the same type have the same configuration. This configuration is called a JobSpec. **JobSpecs** is an array of JobSpec objects that describes the configurations for all types of nodes.

items.description: The runtime configuration of the job.

UserCommand.description: The start command for all nodes in the job.

DataSources.description: The list of data sources used by the job.

items.description:
The list of all data sources that the job uses. Each data source is mounted to a local directory in the container of each node based on the data source configuration. The local directory is specified by the \`MountPath\` parameter in the data source configuration.

The process specified in the start command can then directly access the distributed file system of each data source through its \`MountPath\`.

DataSourceId.description: The ID of the data source.<props="china"> For more information, see [ListDatasets](~~457222~~).</props>

MountPath.description: The path to which the data source is mounted for this job. This parameter is optional. By default, the mount path specified in the data source configuration is used.

Uri.description: The path of the data source.

Options.description: The mount properties for the custom dataset. Currently, only OSS is supported.

CodeSource.description: The code source for the job. Before the job nodes start, PAI-DLC automatically downloads the code from the specified code source and mounts it to a local directory in the container.

CodeSourceId.description: The code source ID.<props="china"> For more information, see [ListCodeSources ](~~459922~~).</props>

Branch.description: The branch of the code repository that the job references. This parameter is optional. By default, the branch specified in the code source configuration is used.

Commit.description: The commit ID of the code to download for the job. This parameter is optional. By default, the commit ID specified in the code source configuration is used.

MountPath.description: The path to which the code source is mounted for this job. This parameter is optional. By default, the mount path specified in the code source configuration is used.

VpcId.description: The ID of the user's VPC.

SwitchId.description:
The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is optional.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically selects a vSwitch based on resource availability.

- You can also specify a vSwitch ID.

SecurityGroupId.description: The ID of the security group.

ExtendedCIDRs.description:
The extended CIDR blocks.

- If you do not specify a vSwitch ID, this parameter is optional. The system automatically obtains all CIDR blocks in the VPC.

- If you specify a vSwitch ID, this parameter is required. Specify all CIDR blocks in the VPC.

DefaultRoute.description:
The default route. Valid values:

- eth0: Uses the default network interface controller (NIC) to access the Internet through a public gateway.

- eth1: Uses the user's elastic network interface (ENI) to access the Internet through a private gateway. For more information about how to configure this, see [Configure a DSW instance to access the Internet through a NAT gateway](~~2525343~~).

ThirdpartyLibs.description: The list of third-party Python libraries to install.

items.description: Specify a third-party Python library and its version requirements, for example: `numpy==1.16.1`.

ThirdpartyLibDir.description: The name of the folder that contains the \`requirements.txt\` file for third-party Python libraries. Before PAI-DLC runs the specified \`UserCommand\` on each node, it retrieves the \`requirements.txt\` file from this folder and runs the `pip install -r` command to install the libraries.

additionalProperties.description:
An environment variable in the `Key=Value` format.
><notice>The environment variable must comply with POSIX standards.></notice>

JobMaxRunningTimeMinutes.description: The maximum running time of the job in minutes.

WorkspaceId.description: The workspace ID.<props="china"> For more information, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).</props>

ResourceId.description:
The ID of the resource group. This parameter is optional.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the job is submitted to the public resource group.

- If a resource quota is attached to the current workspace, you can specify the corresponding resource quota ID. For more information about how to query the resource quota ID, see [Manage resource quotas](~~2651299~~).

Priority.description:
The priority of the job. This parameter is optional. The default value is 1. The value can be an integer from 1 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

- 1 is the lowest priority.

- 9 is the highest priority.

Settings.description: Additional parameter settings for the job.

ElasticSpec.description: This parameter is not supported. You can ignore it.

DebuggerConfigContent.description: This parameter is not supported. You can ignore it.

Options.description: Additional configurations for the job. Use this parameter to adjust the behavior of mounted data sources. For example, if the job has an OSS data source mounted, you can set this parameter to `fs.oss.download.thread.concurrency=4,fs.oss.download.queue.size=16` to overwrite the default parameters of JindoFS.

SuccessPolicy.description:
The success policy for a distributed multi-node job. This is currently supported only for multi-node TensorFlow jobs.

- ChiefWorker: If you set the policy to this value, the entire job is considered successful as long as the chief pod finishes successfully.

- AllWorkers (default): The entire job is considered successful only after all worker pods finish successfully.

Accessibility.description:
The visibility of the job. Valid values:
